selfService.title: Wash it yourself
selfService.lead: Five bays. No waiting for staff. Pay and pick a program.
selfService.step1Body: If a bay is free, pull in and switch off.
selfService.step2Body: The panel takes {coins} coins and card.
selfService.step3Body: Most programs share one price. Exceptions are marked below.
selfService.guideLead: About a minute. No long manual.
selfService.guide1: Park so the lance reaches all sides.
selfService.guide2: Insert a coin or tap a card. Credit shows on the panel.
selfService.guide3: Start with pre-wash, then gel or foam, then rinse. Wax and osmosis if you want gloss.
selfService.guide4: Short water is a finish, not a full wash.
